title: Neuropolis: LLM-based Multi-Agent Social Simulation Platform
description: Developing an open-source, config-driven architecture for multi-agent social and economic simulations. Investigating empirical behavioral economics, dynamic attention steering, and Transactive Memory Systems in large language models to maintain long-horizon agent stability.

title: Evolution Strategies for Scalable Reinforcement Learning
description: Implemented and published an open-source Python and PyTorch reproduction of OpenAI's Evolution Strategies algorithm for highly scalable, derivative-free reinforcement learning.

title: Pollutant Degradation Modeling (Interdisciplinary ML)
description: Analyzed a 240-sample experimental chemical engineering dataset to predict pollutant degradation rates using advanced machine learning regression algorithms, including TabPFN, TabNet, and Gaussian Process Regression.

title: Quantifying Gender Bias in Word Embeddings (GloVe)
description: Conducted an independent statistical analysis of pre-trained GloVe word embeddings across 380+ occupational titles, measuring representational biases against empirical U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics workforce data.

title: Multi-Label Emotion & Personality Classification (B.Sc. Thesis)
description: Developed a deep learning NLP pipeline on the GoEmotions dataset using Transformers, BiGRU, and LSTM architectures, achieving a micro-average F1 score of 48.9%.
